entities.name: Barthélemy Laffemas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Barthélemy de Laffemas was an economist, born in Beausemblant, France in 1545. He is officially recorded as dying in Paris in 1612. However, it is rumoured that he actually died on September 23, 1611, after falling from his horse. He is known as the first person to write about underconsumption
